# ADR-017: Keep source bubble lifecycle and all numeric labels in motion

Status: chosen_for_client_phase_correction

Concerns: Q-state, Q-behavior, Q-evidence

## Decision

Remove synthetic tick-time bubble assignment; admit every source bubble ID to the existing collision kernels. Project actual ECS is_free into source arithmetic. The retained Avian extension reads a derived is_master cache refreshed from ParkMetadata before its schedule and ignores client bubble labels.

## Rationale

An independent unchanged C++ phase trace exposed synthetic client state and missing free-ball inflation. A source-backed collision invariance check exposed fallback physics selected solely by a client numeric label.

## Alternatives

Keep synthetic metadata; special-case label zero; duplicate source numeric or collision engines.

## Consequences

Eighty client source phase states, including 48 nonunit-dt ticks, match real ownership and numeric observations. Collision label invariance holds for both response modes. Full master dead-bubble/keep-alive and complete collision/world correspondence remain open. Removing fabricated bubbles exposed an artificial client proximity guard; the generated correction retains source client sensor execution without initialized labels. Eight unchanged Original scenarios/nine event-list assertions are preserved in the headless host.
